test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

17, 13, 18, 11, 15, 13, 19, 18, 13, 17

The mode of the data is:
solution:
**Given:**

17, 13, 18, 11, 15, 13, 19, 18, 13, 17

**Concept used:**

**Mode: **The entity repeating maximum number of times.

**Calculation:**

In ascending order

11, 13, 13, 13, 15, 17, 17, 18, 18, 19

So, the mode is 13.

**Hence, the mode of the data is** **13.**
